title: Drawing on the Property Credit Standing on a Hotel Rate Plans Reservation
content:
A guest in house may draw on the property credit standing on their own Hotel Rate Plans reservation to meet what they have run up at the property. This note states what such a drawdown is and how it is recorded.

## What the desk is dealing with

The occasion is a stay with property credit standing on it and charges run up at the property. The result governed is the credit the guest draws down. Once the drawdown is recorded, it shows on the folio as value leaving the credit, and the property credit still unspent on the reservation falls by the same amount.

## The capability that records it

`spend_resort_credit_ff384f87` lets the guest spend the property credit standing on their own hotel reservation against what they have run up at the property. One call posts a drawdown line to the reservation's folio for the amount stated, carrying it as value leaving the credit, and lowers the property credit still unspent on the reservation by the same amount.

## How it is invoked

This is the guest's own tool over their own reservation. It is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves, rather than run by the desk on their behalf.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | the internal reference number of the guest's own hotel reservation the credit stands on | an identifier, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call |
| `credit_reference` | the reference of the property credit being spent | taken from the folio line that granted it and copied character for character as it appears there, preserving wording, digits, letter case and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| `credit_applied_usd` | the property credit the guest draws down | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the second decimal and at no earlier point, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol; zero is written 0.0 and means no credit is drawn down |

None of the three parameters carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A single line of confirmation text. It names the reference of the drawdown line just created on the folio, the credit reference it was drawn against, the amount drawn down as a USD figure with two decimal places, and the property credit left unspent afterwards as a USD figure with two decimal places. The text coming back at all is what indicates the drawdown was posted; an absent line or an error text means the credit is untouched.
